en.quote: Woe unto you that desire the day of the LORD! to what end is it for you? the day of the LORD is darkness, and not light.
en.riddle: Wherefore would ye have the day of the LORD?
en.speaker: Woe unto you
en.listener: that desire the day of the LORD

he.quote: הוֹי הַמִּתְאַוִּים אֶת-יוֹם יְהוָה לָמָּה-זֶּה לָכֶם יוֹם יְהוָה הוּא-חֹשֶׁךְ וְלֹא-אֽוֹר
he.speaker: הוֹי הַמִּתְאַוִּים
